SOUNDS_DECK.Title: Sounds Deck
SOUNDS_DECK.NoBeds: No bed yet. A playlist whose name starts with a number and a dot (1 · …) appears here.
SOUNDS_DECK.Layout: Board beside or below the beds
SOUNDS_DECK.NoBanks: No bank yet. A playlist whose name starts with an emoji appears here: Soundboard Only for one-shots, Simultaneous for room loops, Sequential for events.
SOUNDS_DECK.NoPress: Shuffle mode gives these pads nothing to do: choose Soundboard Only, Simultaneous or Sequential.
SOUNDS_DECK.DucksOn: The music drops under this event - click to keep it at full
SOUNDS_DECK.DucksOff: The music stays at full under this event - click to lower it
SOUNDS_DECK.Filter: Filter the pads - glass, heartbeat, ponctuels…

Help.Title: How the deck reads your playlists
Help.Intro: Sounds Deck plays Foundry's own playlists. Two things decide everything: the playlist's name and its mode.
Help.Bed: A name that starts with a number and a dot (1 · Calm) is music: a card, one playing at a time.
Help.Bank: A name that starts with an emoji (💥 Effects) is a bank of pads. Its mode decides what a pad does:
Help.OneShot: Soundboard Only: a one-shot, heard by everyone, and it can overlap itself.
Help.Toggle: Simultaneous: a loop you switch on and off; the others keep playing.
Help.Cue: Sequential: an event, with pause, stop and position below the board; the music drops under it (the small speaker beside the pad turns that off).
Help.Shuffle: Shuffle: nothing - the bank is shown greyed.
Help.Neither: A name with neither stays off the deck.
Help.Scenes: A scene that carries a playlist starts its music when it opens. Music you pick by hand keeps playing into a scene that has none.
Help.Source: Hover a pad to see where its sound comes from: the sound's own description in the playlist sidebar.
Help.Moods: Moods (above the music) save what plays - music, room loops and their levels, random effects - and bring it back in one click. Events are left alone.

Journal.Name: Sounds Deck: keep a press log on this seat
Journal.Hint: Off by default. Records each press on the deck (music, pads, events) with the time, in this browser only, so a session can be reviewed afterwards. Export it from the deck's menu.

SOUNDS_DECK.RandomOn: Firing at random moments - click to stop
SOUNDS_DECK.RandomOff: Fire this at random moments (every 10–45 s)
SOUNDS_DECK.PreviewOn: In your ear only - click to stop
SOUNDS_DECK.PreviewOff: Hear this in your ear only - the table does not

Crossfade.Name: Crossfade between beds (seconds)
Crossfade.Hint: When the music changes from one bed to another - a bed card, or a mood that brings another bed - the new bed starts first and the old one fades out once the new one is heard. Both fade over this time, in every browser. 0 cuts straight across.

HideSources.Name: Hide sources on the deck
HideSources.Hint: A sound's source written in parentheses at the end of its name - "At Risk (Gone Girl)" - and its description stay in Foundry's playlist sidebar; the deck shows "At Risk". The filter still searches the full name.

SOUNDS_DECK.MoodSave: Save what plays as a mood
SOUNDS_DECK.MoodDeleteConfirm: Delete the mood "{name}"? Nothing that plays is stopped.
SOUNDS_DECK.MoodEmpty: Nothing to save: start a bed, a room loop or a random effect first.
SOUNDS_DECK.MoodMissing: {count} part(s) of this mood no longer exist and were skipped.

SceneMood.Label: Mood (Sounds Deck)
SceneMood.Hint: A saved mood this scene brings back when it opens: its music, loops and random effects, exactly as its card does. It takes the place of the scene playlist above.

SOUNDS_DECK.MoodNone: No mood yet. Set up a bed, loops and random effects, then save them here.

Down.bed: Music level down (Stream Deck + knob 1, turn left)
Down.toggle: Loops level down (Stream Deck + knob 2, turn left)
Down.cue: Events level down (Stream Deck + knob 3, turn left)
Down.oneshot: Effects level down (Stream Deck + knob 4, turn left)

SOUNDS_DECK.PadGone: This pad no longer exists in the world.
SOUNDS_DECK.Muted: Muted - press its knob again to bring it back

Trim.Label: Trim
Trim.Hint: Play only part of this track: from Start to End, in seconds (Sounds Deck). It ends at End, so a shuffle moves on; a repeating sound repeats that part. Leave empty for the whole file.

Look.Label: Pad
Look.Hint: How this sound's pad looks on the Sounds Deck: a colour from six, and an icon (an emoji) before its name.

Private.Tooltip: Only the players you choose hear it, once; you hear it quietly
Private.Title: Only they hear it
Private.Intro: Who hears {name}? It plays once on their machines, and quietly in yours.

Accent.Name: Accent colour
Accent.Hint: The colour of everything lit on the deck: a playing card, a pressed pad, progress lines, the ripple. On this computer only.
Accent.CustomHint: Used when the accent colour is set to Custom.

Tabs.Label: Banks shown on the board
Tabs.Solo: Show this bank alone; click again to show them all
